items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They were saying when Joshua and these walls were – certain controls were hit.

ctx.x: You get into it. You get totally into it. But if you think about all that stuff with no music . . .
It’s something I was reading – I don’t know whether you’ve read it – from The Book of Knowledge. They were saying when Joshua and these walls were – certain controls were hit.
